Hi Alex — thanks for the repro. I tried to reproduce locally against sandbox and have a couple of quick asks and suggestions: 

1) SDK version: can you confirm exact package + sha (you mentioned v1.3.2). We recently shipped a minor patch to token header handling; older SDKs can inadvertently send malformed auth headers.

2) Full request payload: the sample you sent looks ok, but the reranker expects the documents array to have only {id,text} pairs — any extra nested metadata should be stripped. Can you attach the exact payload you POSTed?

3) Timeout tuning: the client default timeout is 30s. In some large rerank requests we see backend work exceed that and trigger internal retries that surface as 5xx. Immediate workaround: increase client timeout to 60s. Example (Node):

// Node SDK — increase timeout
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, timeout: 60000 });

4) Routing header workaround: you can force route to the stable reranker pool while we triage by setting header X-Route: stable. That avoids a canary instance we suspect is flaky.

If you can share the exact payload + confirmation of SDK version, I'll run it through our sandbox and post logs.

-Neha
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Finlytics — 5xx errors on embed/reranker calls

Alex / team — I reproduced the issue using your repro steps in sandbox. Attached redwood_logs.txt with the service-side stacktrace. Short summary:

- Error: 500 in reranker-service during scoring phase (see logs).
- Root cause: null pointer when an item in documents[] was missing "text" after our structured-output normalization step. This path is hit when clients send extra metadata objects in documents and our normalizer drops those fields.
- Temporary mitigation: set header X-Route: stable and increase client timeout to 60s. I deployed a config to staging that adds defensive checks to the normalizer; will push a hotfix to sandbox later today.

Please try the following now:
1) Use payload_sample.json (attached) — trimmed to id/text only.
2) Add header: X-Route: stable
3) Increase client timeout to 65s (gives buffer)

I've filed INC-1423 in Jira and linked logs: https://jira.redwood.ai/INC-1423.

Attachments: redwood_logs.txt

Thanks,
Rishi
Support Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
